children.text: Greeting and Purpose
Hi, Yaming. What are you doing?
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 嗨，亚明。你在做什么？
children.notes: What are you doing? 用于询问正在进行的动作。
children.statement: 这句话询问的是过去发生的事情。
children.explanation: 这句话使用的是现在进行时，询问的是现在正在做的事情。

children.text: Hi, Emma. I'm starting a test on animals and plants.
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 嗨，艾玛。我正在开始一项关于动植物的测试。
children.notes: starting a test = 开始一场测试
children.statement: 这句话使用了现在进行时。
children.explanation: I'm starting 表示正在进行的动作。

children.text: Sounds fun. Let's take it together.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 听起来很有趣。我们一起做吧。
children.notes: Sounds fun = 听起来很有趣；Let's = Let us
children.statement: Sounds fun 意思是“听起来很无聊”。
children.explanation: fun 的意思是“有趣”。

children.cn: 问候与测试目的

children.text: Animal Trivia
Largest & Heaviest Animal
OK. First question. What's the largest animal in the world?
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 好的。第一个问题。世界上最大的动物是什么？
children.notes: largest = 最大的（最高级）
children.statement: largest 是 large 的最高级形式。
children.explanation: 形容词最高级通常在词尾加 -est。

children.text: It's the blue whale, right?
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 是蓝鲸，对吧？
children.notes: blue whale = 蓝鲸
children.statement: right 在句末表示“对吧”。
children.explanation: 在句末加 right 可以表示反问确认。

children.text: Right. It's also the heaviest animal on earth. Next question. Which animal runs the fastest?
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 对。它也是地球上最重的动物。下一个问题。哪种动物跑得最快？
children.notes: heaviest = 最重的；fastest = 最快的
children.statement: heaviest 是 heavy 的最高级。
children.explanation: heavy 以辅音字母+y结尾，变y为i加est。

children.cn: 最大且最重的动物

children.text: Fastest & Most Beautiful Animal
Oh wait! I just read about it. The cheetah runs the fastest.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 哦等等！我刚读到过。猎豹跑得最快。
children.notes: cheetah = 猎豹
children.statement: cheetah 是一种鸟类。
children.explanation: cheetah 是猎豹，属于哺乳动物。

children.text: Right again! And I think it's the most beautiful animal in the world.
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 又对了！而且我认为它是世界上最美丽的动物。
children.notes: most beautiful = 最美丽的
children.statement: beautiful 的最高级是在词尾加 -est。
children.explanation: 多音节形容词最高级要在前面加 most。

children.text: I completely agree with you.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 我完全同意你的看法。
children.notes: agree with = 同意
children.statement: completely 是副词，修饰 agree。
children.explanation: 副词可以修饰动词。

children.cn: 跑得最快与最美丽的动物
动物小知识

children.text: Plant Trivia
Oldest Plant: Moss
Now let's answer the questions about plants. What is the oldest plant in the world?
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 现在我们来回答关于植物的问题。世界上最古老的植物是什么？
children.notes: oldest = 最古老的
children.statement: oldest 是 old 的最高级。
children.explanation: old 的最高级是 oldest。

children.text: Hmm, I'm not sure. Do you have any idea?
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 嗯，我不确定。你知道吗？
children.notes: not sure = 不确定；have any idea = 有主意/知道吗
children.statement: I'm not sure 意思是“我确定”。
children.explanation: not sure 表示不确定。

children.text: Well, I think moss is one of the oldest plants. It appeared on earth around 470 million years ago... Oh, look here. I'm correct!
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 嗯，我认为苔藓是最古老的植物之一。它大约在4.7亿年前出现在地球上……哦，看这里。我是对的！
children.notes: moss = 苔藓；appeared = 出现；correct = 正确的
children.statement: moss 是一种动物。
children.explanation: moss 是苔藓，属于植物。

children.text: Interesting! Let's go on!
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 有趣！我们继续吧！
children.notes: go on = 继续
children.statement: go on 意思是“停止”。
children.explanation: go on 的意思是“继续”。

children.cn: 最古老的植物：苔藓

children.text: Tallest Tree: Redwood
Which kind of tree is the tallest in the world?
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 哪种树是世界上最高的？
children.notes: tallest = 最高的
children.statement: tallest 是 tall 的最高级。
children.explanation: tall 的最高级是 tallest。

children.text: The redwood tree, right?
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 红杉树，对吧？
children.notes: redwood tree = 红杉树
children.statement: redwood tree 是一种树。
children.explanation: redwood tree 是红杉树。

children.text: Yes! I hope I can see some one day.
children.speaker: Yaming
children.cn: 是的！我希望有一天能亲眼见到一些。
children.notes: hope = 希望；one day = 有一天
children.statement: hope 后面通常接不定式或宾语从句。
children.explanation: I hope I can see... 是 hope 接宾语从句的用法。

children.cn: 最高的树：红杉
植物小知识

tree.text: Ella & Chen Jie's folding fan conversation

children.text: Introduction: Folding Fan
Oh, what's that, Chen Jie? It's so beautiful!
children.cn: 噢，那是什么，陈洁？它太漂亮了！
children.statement: 艾拉觉得陈洁手里的东西非常漂亮。
children.explanation: 艾拉赞叹道：'It's so beautiful!' (它太漂亮了！)。陈述正确。

children.text: Thanks. It's a folding fan. I bought it last year.
children.cn: 谢谢。这是一把折扇。我去年买的。
children.statement: 这把折扇是陈洁最近刚刚买的。
children.explanation: 陈洁说：'I bought it last year.' (我去年买的)。陈述错误。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
Ella

children.cn: 引子：中国折扇

children.text: Bamboo in Chinese Culture
Oh! It has a painting of bamboo on it.
children.cn: 哦！上面画着竹子。
children.statement: 折扇上画的是牡丹花。
children.explanation: 艾拉说：'It has a painting of bamboo on it.' (上面画着竹子)。陈述错误。

children.text: Yeah. Bamboo is one of the most popular subjects in Chinese paintings.
children.cn: 是的。竹子是中国画中最受欢迎的题材之一。
children.statement: 竹子在中国画中是很罕见的题材。
children.explanation: 陈洁提到：'Bamboo is one of the most popular subjects...' (竹子是最受欢迎的题材之一)。陈述错误。

children.text: It's a symbol of goodness in Chinese culture.
children.cn: 在中国文化中，它是美德的象征。
children.statement: 竹子在中国文化中象征着美德与正直。
children.explanation: 陈洁说竹子是 'symbol of goodness in Chinese culture' (美德的象征)。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
Chen Jie
Ella

children.cn: 中国文化中的竹子象征

children.text: The Bamboo Sea in Sichuan
I didn't know that before. So, where did you get that fan?
children.cn: 我以前不知道这回事。那么，你从哪里买到这把扇子的？
children.statement: 艾拉以前就知道竹子在中国文化中的特殊含义。
children.explanation: 艾拉说：'I didn't know that before.' (我以前不知道)。陈述错误。

children.text: At the Bamboo Sea in Sichuan, the largest and oldest bamboo forest in China.
children.cn: 在四川的蜀南竹海，中国最大、最古老的竹林。
children.statement: 蜀南竹海是中国最大、最年轻的竹林。
children.explanation: 陈洁说那是 'largest and oldest' (最大和最古老) 的竹林，而不是最年轻的。陈述错误。

children.text: I learnt lots of interesting things when I was there.
children.cn: 我在那里的时候学到了很多有趣的事情。
children.statement: 陈洁在蜀南竹海游玩时学到了很多有趣的知识。
children.explanation: 陈洁明确表达 'I learnt lots of interesting things when I was there.'。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
Chen Jie
Ella

children.cn: 四川蜀南竹海

children.text: Interesting Bamboo Facts
Growth Speed & Appearance
Really? Like what?
children.cn: 真的吗？比如什么？
children.statement: 艾拉对陈洁学到的趣事不感兴趣。
children.explanation: 艾拉追问道 'Like what?' (比如什么？)，表现出极大的兴趣。陈述错误。

children.text: Well, bamboo is one of the fastest-growing plants.
children.cn: 嗯，竹子是生长最快的植物之一。
children.statement: 竹子是世界上生长最缓慢的植物。
children.explanation: 陈洁说竹子是 'one of the fastest-growing plants' (生长最快的植物之一)。陈述错误。
children.speaker: Chen Jie

children.text: Some bamboo can grow almost one metre in one day.
children.keywords: grow, almost one metre, one day
children.cn: 有些竹子一天几乎能长一米。
children.statement: 竹子可以在一天内长高近一米。
children.explanation: 陈洁明确说：'grow almost one metre in one day' (一天内几乎能长一米)。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
Ella

children.cn: 竹子生长速度与外观

children.text: Practical Uses of Bamboo
Also, it's one of the most useful plants in the world.
children.cn: 此外，它是世界上最实用的植物之一。
children.statement: 竹子在日常生活中几乎没有任何实用价值。
children.explanation: 陈洁说竹子是 'one of the most useful plants in the world' (最实用的植物之一)。陈述错误。

children.text: People can use it to build houses and make tools and instruments.
children.cn: 人们可以用它来盖房子，制造工具和乐器。
children.statement: 人们可以用竹子盖房子、制造工具和乐器。
children.explanation: 陈洁明确指出人们用竹子来 'build houses and make tools and instruments'。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
Chen Jie

children.cn: 竹子的实用价值
有趣的竹子事实

children.text: Pandas & Food
Oh, that's interesting. I remember pandas love to eat bamboo too, right?
children.cn: 噢，那很有趣。我记得大熊猫也喜欢吃竹子，对吧？
children.statement: 艾拉提到熊猫喜欢吃竹叶和竹茎。
children.explanation: 艾拉提问大熊猫是否也爱吃竹子。陈述正确。

children.text: Exactly! Actually we eat bamboo shoots too. They're really delicious.
children.cn: 没错！其实我们也吃竹笋。它们真的很美味。
children.statement: 人类并不食用竹笋。
children.explanation: 陈洁说：'Actually we eat bamboo shoots too.' (实际上我们也吃竹笋)，它们很美味。陈述错误。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
Ella

children.cn: 大熊猫与竹笋美食

tree.cn: 艾拉与陈洁关于折扇的对话

children.text: Living Fossil & History
children.cn: 活化石与历史渊源

children.text: The ginkgo tree is one of the most ancient living trees on earth.
children.keywords: ginkgo tree, most ancient living trees
children.cn: 银杏树是地球上最古老的现存树种之一。
children.notes: one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词，表示“最……之一”。ancient 的最高级为 most ancient。
children.statement: 银杏树是地球上最古老的现存树木之一。
children.explanation: 文中明确提到'one of the most ancient living trees on earth'。陈述正确。

children.text: Ginkgo trees first appeared over 200 million years ago.
children.cn: 银杏树最早出现在两亿多年前。
children.notes: first appeared 表示“最早出现/首次出现”；over = more than（超过）。
children.statement: 银杏树大约在200年前才首次出现。
children.explanation: 文中指出是200 million years ago（两亿多年前），而不是200年前。陈述错误。

children.text: Cultural Symbol & Scenic Tree
children.cn: 文化象征与著名古树

children.text: Chinese people love the ginkgo, as it is a symbol of hope and long life.
children.cn: 中国人喜爱银杏，因为它是希望与长寿的象征。
children.notes: as 引导原因状语从句，相当于 because；a symbol of... 表示“……的象征”。
children.statement: 在中华文化中，银杏象征着希望与长寿。
children.explanation: 文中提到'it is a symbol of hope and long life'。陈述正确。

children.text: Many Chinese believe that the old ginkgo tree in the Zhongnan Mountains in Shaanxi Province is the most beautiful tree.
children.cn: 许多中国人认为，陕西终南山上的那棵古银杏树是最美丽的树。
children.notes: believe that 引导宾语从句；the most beautiful 为多音节形容词最高级。
children.statement: 陕西终南山有一棵被许多人认为最美丽的古银杏树。
children.explanation: 文中指出许多人认为终南山的古银杏树是'the most beautiful tree'。陈述正确。

children.text: Thousands of tourists come to see it each year, especially in mid-October, as it is the best time to see it.
children.keywords: thousands of tourists, mid-October, best time
children.cn: 每年成千上万的游客前来观赏它，尤其是在十月中旬，因为那是观赏的最佳时节。
children.notes: thousands of 表示“成千上万的”；the best time to do sth 表示“做某事的最佳时机”。
children.statement: 十月中旬是观赏这棵古银杏树的最佳时间。
children.explanation: 文中提到'especially in mid-October, as it is the best time to see it'。陈述正确。

children.text: Urban Presence & Autumn Joy
children.cn: 城市景观与秋季赏景

children.text: The ginkgo tree is one of the most common trees in streets, parks, and gardens across China.
children.keywords: most common trees, streets, parks, across China
children.cn: 在中国各地的街道、公园和花园里，银杏树是最常见的树木之一。
children.notes: most common 表示“最常见的”；across China 表示“全中国各地”。
children.statement: 在中国的街道和公园里很难见到银杏树。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出银杏树是'one of the most common trees'（最常见的树之一）。陈述错误。

children.text: When autumn comes, one of the most popular activities is to take a walk under ginkgo trees.
children.keywords: autumn comes, popular activities, take a walk
children.cn: 当秋天来临时，最受欢迎的活动之一就是在银杏树下散步。
children.notes: when 引导时间状语从句；to take a walk 动词不定式作表语。
children.statement: 秋天在银杏树下散步是一项很受欢迎的活动。
children.explanation: 文中指出'one of the most popular activities is to take a walk under ginkgo trees'。陈述正确。

children.text: People believe the bright yellow leaves can bring joy to their heart.
children.keywords: bright yellow leaves, bring joy, heart
children.cn: 人们相信，明亮金黄的叶子能给他们的心灵带来喜悦。
children.notes: bring joy to one's heart 表示“给某人内心带来欢乐”；bright yellow leaves 指明黄色的树叶。
children.statement: 人们认为金黄色的银杏树叶能够带来快乐的心情。
children.explanation: 文中提到'the bright yellow leaves can bring joy to their heart'。陈述正确。

children.text: Paragraph 1: Supermarket Scenario & Connection
Supermarket Thought Experiment
Imagine you go to the supermarket in your area, but there are almost no fruits, vegetables, honey, milk, eggs, or chocolate.
children.cn: 想象一下，你去了你所在地区的超市，但几乎没有水果、蔬菜、蜂蜜、牛奶、鸡蛋或巧克力。
children.notes: almost no: 几乎没有
children.statement: 这里假设超市里货物非常充足。
children.explanation: 文章让我们想象 'almost no fruits...' (几乎没有水果等)，说明是缺乏货物的场景。陈述错误。

children.text: How would you feel? Disappointed? Angry? Sad?
children.cn: 你会怎么想？失望？生气？伤心？
children.notes: disappointed / angry / sad: 描述心情的形容词
children.statement: 在这种情况下，人们通常会感到非常高兴。
children.explanation: 当超市里没有食物时，人们会感到失望、生气或悲伤。陈述错误。

children.cn: 超市缺货的思想实验

children.text: Interconnectedness of Life
At this moment you realize people, plants, and animals are all connected.
children.cn: 在这一刻，你意识到人、植物和动物都是相互联系的。
children.notes: connected: 连接的，相互联系的
children.statement: 作者认为人与自然界是完全孤立、互不影响的。
children.explanation: 作者指出：'people, plants, and animals are all connected' (人类、植物和动物都是相互联系的)。陈述错误。

children.text: We need each other to live, and bees are one of the best examples of this connection.
children.cn: 我们需要彼此才能生存，而蜜蜂是这种联系最好的例子之一。
children.notes: each other: 彼此；example of: ……的例子
children.statement: 蜜蜂展现了人类、植物和动物之间紧密联系的最好例子之一。
children.explanation: 蜜蜂的授粉活动对植物生长及人类食物供应至关重要，是这一联系的极佳例证。陈述正确。

children.cn: 人、植物与动物的相互依存
第1段：超市场景与生命相连

children.text: Paragraph 2: Pollination & Ecological Importance
Pollination Process & Trip
Bees are very hard-working animals, and their greatest work is pollination.
children.cn: 蜜蜂是非常勤劳的动物，它们最伟大的工作是传粉。
children.notes: hard-working: 勤劳的；pollination: 授粉
children.statement: 蜜蜂最伟大的工作是制作蜂蜡，而不是传粉。
children.explanation: 文中明确写道 'their greatest work is pollination' (它们最伟大的工作是传粉)。陈述错误。

children.text: On one trip, they often visit 50 to 100 flowers.
children.cn: 在一次出行中，它们经常访问50到100朵花。
children.notes: on one trip: 在一次出行/往返中
children.statement: 蜜蜂每次出行往往只飞向一两朵花。
children.explanation: 文中指出它们每次出行 'often visit 50 to 100 flowers' (经常访问50到100朵花)。陈述错误。

children.text: As they fly from one flower to another, they take pollen with them.
children.cn: 当它们从一朵花飞到另一朵花时，它们随身带走花粉。
children.notes: from one... to another: 从一个……到另一个；pollen: 花粉
children.statement: 蜜蜂在花丛间飞行时会随身携带并传播花粉。
children.explanation: 蜜蜂从一朵花飞到另一朵花时会携带花粉进行传播。陈述正确。

children.cn: 蜜蜂传粉过程与单次飞行

children.text: Impact on Global Plants
This action helps plants grow.
children.cn: 这种行为有助于植物生长。
children.notes: help sb/sth do sth: 帮助某人/某物做某事
children.statement: 蜜蜂传粉的动作对植物的生长没有任何帮助。
children.explanation: 文中指出传粉动作 'helps plants grow' (帮助植物生长)。陈述错误。

children.text: In fact, without their work, about 80 per cent of the plants in the world cannot grow.
children.cn: 事实上，如果没有它们的工作，世界上大约百分之八十的植物都无法生长。
children.notes: per cent: 百分之……；without: 没有
children.statement: 没有蜜蜂授粉，世界上大约80%的植物仍可照常生长。
children.explanation: 如果没有蜜蜂的授粉工作，世界上约有80%的植物将‘无法生长’ (cannot grow)。陈述错误。

children.text: For this reason, many scientists believe that bees are the most important animals on this planet.
children.cn: 出于这个原因，许多科学家相信蜜蜂是这个星球上最重要的动物。
children.notes: for this reason: 出于这个原因
children.statement: 因为蜜蜂对生态极为重要，科学家认为它们是地球上最重要的动物。
children.explanation: 由于授粉对植物生长的重要性，科学家认为蜜蜂是地球上最重要的动物。陈述正确。

children.cn: 对全球植物生长的深远影响
第2段：授粉与生态重要性

children.text: Paragraph 3: Honeycombs & Bee Dance Communication
Building Honeycombs
Bees are also one of the most interesting animals in the world.
children.cn: 蜜蜂也是世界上最有趣的动物之一。
children.notes: one of the most interesting: 最有趣的……之一
children.statement: 作者认为蜜蜂是世界上最乏味单调的动物。
children.explanation: 作者说蜜蜂是 'one of the most interesting animals in the world'。陈述错误。

children.text: For example, they work hard together to make their homes.
children.cn: 例如，它们共同努力建造它们的家园。
children.notes: work hard together: 共同辛勤工作
children.statement: 蜜蜂是单独行动，不会合作建造家园的。
children.explanation: 文中提到 'they work hard together to make their homes'。陈述错误。

children.text: In order to store honey, they create honeycombs.
children.cn: 为了储存蜂蜜，它们创造了蜂巢。
children.notes: in order to: 为了；honeycomb: 蜂巢
children.statement: 蜜蜂建造蜂巢的主要目的是为了储存蜂蜜。
children.explanation: 文中说明 'In order to store honey, they create honeycombs'。陈述正确。

children.cn: 勤劳合作建造蜂巢

children.text: The Waggle Dance Communication
Another interesting thing about bees is how they communicate.
children.cn: 蜜蜂的另一个有趣之处在于它们是如何交流的。
children.notes: communicate: 交流，沟通
children.statement: 蜜蜂之间完全没有任何交流沟通的方式。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出蜜蜂有它们独特的交流方式 (how they communicate)。陈述错误。

children.text: When a bee finds new food, it uses a dance to tell the others where and how far away the food is.
children.keywords: finds food, dance, how far away
children.cn: 当一只蜜蜂找到新的食物时，它会跳舞告诉其他蜜蜂食物在哪里以及有多远。
children.notes: how far away: 多远
children.statement: 蜜蜂通过跳舞向同伴传递食物的位置和距离信息。
children.explanation: 蜜蜂通过舞蹈 (dance) 告知同伴食物的方向和距离。陈述正确。

children.cn: 神奇的跳舞交流方式
第3段：建造蜂巢与舞蹈交流

children.text: Paragraph 4: Population Crisis & Call to Action
Threat in the Ecosystem
Bees play an important part in the ecosystem of our planet.
children.cn: 蜜蜂在地球生态系统中起着重要作用。
children.notes: play an important part in: 在……中起重要作用；ecosystem: 生态系统
children.statement: 蜜蜂对地球的生态平衡起着至关重要的作用。
children.explanation: 蜜蜂在地球生态系统 (ecosystem) 中扮演重要角色。陈述正确。

children.text: However, the number of bees is dropping, and scientists are worried.
children.cn: 然而，蜜蜂的数量正在下降，科学家们对此感到担忧。
children.notes: drop: 下降，减少
children.statement: 目前世界上蜜蜂的数量正逐年稳步上升。
children.explanation: 文中指出 'the number of bees is dropping' (数量正在下降)，这让科学家很担忧。陈述错误。

children.cn: 生态系统面临的危机

children.text: Protecting Amazing Creatures
Bees need our help, and there is a lot we can do.
children.keywords: need help, a lot we can do
children.cn: 蜜蜂需要我们的帮助，我们有很多可以做的事情。
children.notes: a lot we can do: 我们能做的很多事情
children.statement: 面对蜜蜂危机，人类完全无能为力。
children.explanation: 作者指出 'there is a lot we can do' (我们有很多可以做的事情)。陈述错误。

children.text: Think about what you can do to protect one of the most amazing animals on earth.
children.cn: 想一想你可以做些什么来保护地球上最神奇的动物之一。
children.notes: protect: 保护；amazing: 令人惊叹的，神奇的
children.statement: 作者呼吁我们采取行动保护蜜蜂。
children.explanation: 作者希望我们思考能做什么来保护蜜蜂这类神奇的动物。陈述正确。

children.cn: 呼吁共同保护神奇生物
第4段：种群危机与保护呼吁

tree.cn: 没有蜜蜂我们无法生存

children.text: Ecological Role & Size
children.cn: 生态角色与体型差异

children.text: You may not realize it, but frogs play an important role in our ecosystem.
children.keywords: frogs, play an important role, ecosystem
children.cn: 你可能没有意识到，但是青蛙在我们的生态系统中扮演着重要角色。
children.notes: play an important role in... 表示“在……中发挥重要作用/扮演重要角色”。
children.statement: 青蛙在自然生态系统中发挥着重要作用。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出'frogs play an important role in our ecosystem'。陈述正确。

children.text: The smallest frogs are about the size of a pea, while larger ones can grow as big as a human hand.
children.keywords: smallest frogs, size of a pea, human hand
children.cn: 最小的青蛙大约只有豌豆那么大，而较大的青蛙可以长到人类手掌那么大。
children.notes: the size of... 表示“……的大小”；while 表对比；as big as 表示“与……一样大”。
children.statement: 最小的青蛙体型通常和成年人的手掌一样大。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出最小的青蛙大约是豌豆大小（the size of a pea），较大者才有人手大。陈述错误。

children.text: Many people know that frogs help to protect farms by eating insects.
children.cn: 许多人知道青蛙通过捕食昆虫来帮助保护农田。
children.notes: help to do sth 表示“帮助做某事”；by doing 表示通过某种方式。
children.statement: 青蛙通过吃掉害虫来协助保护农场。
children.explanation: 文中提到'frogs help to protect farms by eating insects'。陈述正确。

children.text: Habitat & Scientific Importance
children.cn: 栖息环境与科研价值

children.text: However, not everyone understands their importance in nature.
children.cn: 然而，并非每个人都能理解它们在自然界中的重要性。
children.notes: not everyone 表示部分否定，“并非所有人”；importance 为名词，“重要性”。
children.statement: 自然界中的每个人都十分理解青蛙的重要性。
children.explanation: 文中指出'not everyone understands their importance'（并非所有人都理解）。陈述错误。

children.text: Frogs can live on land and in water.
children.cn: 青蛙既能在陆地上生活，也能在水中生存。
children.notes: on land and in water 指水陆两栖的生活环境。
children.statement: 青蛙是水陆两栖动物，能在陆地和水中生活。
children.explanation: 文中说明'Frogs can live on land and in water'。陈述正确。

children.text: Because of this, they are popular subjects in studies on climate change and the ecosystem.
children.cn: 正因为如此，它们成为气候变化与生态系统研究中广受欢迎的研究对象。
children.notes: because of 后接名词或代词；popular subjects 表示“热门研究课题/对象”。
children.statement: 青蛙常被用作气候变化和生态系统研究的课题对象。
children.explanation: 文中提到'popular subjects in studies on climate change and the ecosystem'。陈述正确。

children.text: Paragraph 1: Size & Graceful Giant
children.cn: 第1段：庞大体量与壮观景象

children.text: The blue whale is the largest and heaviest animal on earth.
children.cn: 蓝鲸是地球上体型最大、体重最重的动物。
children.notes: the largest and heaviest 为最高级并列，意为“最大最重的”。
children.statement: 蓝鲸是地球上最大、最重的动物。
children.explanation: 文中指出'the blue whale is the largest and heaviest animal on earth'。陈述正确。

children.text: It can weigh as much as 200 tons.
children.cn: 它的体重可高达200吨。
children.notes: weigh 动词，“重量为”；as much as 意为“多达……，高达……”。
children.statement: 蓝鲸的体重最多只有20吨重。
children.explanation: 文中指出'It can weigh as much as 200 tons'（高达200吨）。陈述错误。

children.text: Many people like watching blue whales swim, and they think it is one of the most beautiful things to see.
children.keywords: watching blue whales swim, most beautiful things
children.cn: 许多人喜欢观看蓝鲸游泳，他们认为这是最美丽的景象之一。
children.notes: watch sb do sth 表示观看某人做某事的全过程；one of the most beautiful things 表示最美的事物之一。
children.statement: 很多人觉得观看蓝鲸游动是最动人的景观之一。
children.explanation: 文中提到'they think it is one of the most beautiful things to see'。陈述正确。

children.text: Paragraph 2: Habitat & Tiny Diet
children.cn: 第2段：栖息海域与微小食物

children.text: Blue whales live in all oceans except the Arctic Ocean.
children.keywords: all oceans, except the Arctic Ocean
children.cn: 除了北冰洋，蓝鲸生活在世界各大洋中。
children.notes: except 表示“除……之外（不包括）”；the Arctic Ocean 指北冰洋。
children.statement: 北冰洋中也生活着大量的蓝鲸。
children.explanation: 文中明确提到'except the Arctic Ocean'（北冰洋除外）。陈述错误。

children.text: They eat a lot, but they eat some of the tiniest animals in the ocean.
children.keywords: eat a lot, tiniest animals in the ocean
children.cn: 它们食量巨大，但它们吃的却是海洋中一些最微小的动物。
children.notes: tiniest 为 tiny（微小的）的最高级形式；but 连接转折分句。
children.statement: 蓝鲸虽然巨大，吃的却是海洋中极其微小的生物。
children.explanation: 文中提到'they eat some of the tiniest animals in the ocean'。陈述正确。

children.text: A blue whale can eat around four tons of these a day.
children.cn: 一只蓝鲸一天可以吃大约四吨这样的微小动物。
children.notes: around four tons 表示“大约四吨”；a day 表示“每天”。
children.statement: 一只蓝鲸每天能够吃掉大约4吨的微小生物。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出'around four tons of these a day'。陈述正确。

children.text: Paragraph 3: Lifespan, Whale Fall & Protection
children.cn: 第3段：寿命长久、鲸落滋养与物种保护

children.text: Blue whales can live up to 90 years.
children.cn: 蓝鲸的寿命可长达90年。
children.notes: live up to... 表示“活到（某岁数）”；up to 意为“多达，长达”。
children.statement: 蓝鲸最长可以活到大约90岁。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出'Blue whales can live up to 90 years'。陈述正确。

children.text: When a blue whale dies at sea, it becomes food for many kinds of animals living in and around the sea.
children.keywords: dies at sea, becomes food, many kinds of animals
children.cn: 当蓝鲸在海里死去时，它会成为生活在海洋中及周围许多种动物的食物。
children.notes: dies at sea 意为“死在海上”；living in and around the sea 为现在分词短语作后置定语。
children.statement: 死亡的蓝鲸能为海洋内外的许多生物提供养分和食物。
children.explanation: 文中提到'it becomes food for many kinds of animals living in and around the sea'（鲸落）。陈述正确。

children.text: This food lasts for over a year and it helps to create a lively and healthy ecosystem.
children.keywords: lasts for over a year, lively and healthy ecosystem
children.cn: 这些食物可持续一年多，有助于营造一个充满生机且健康的生态系统。
children.notes: lasts for over a year 表示“持续一年多”；lively and healthy ecosystem 表示生机勃勃且健康的生态系统。
children.statement: 死去的蓝鲸带来的食物来源可以持续维持超过一年时间。
children.explanation: 文中提到'This food lasts for over a year'。陈述正确。

children.text: Blue whales play an important role in our world, so we must protect them.
children.keywords: play an important role, must protect them
children.cn: 蓝鲸在我们的世界中扮演着重要角色，因此我们必须保护它们。
children.notes: play an important role in... 表示“在……中起重要作用”；must protect 表示“必须保护”。
children.statement: 因为蓝鲸对世界生态起着重要作用，我们必须对它们施加保护。
children.explanation: 文中总结指出'Blue whales play an important role in our world, so we must protect them'。陈述正确。

children.text: Trouble in the Foggy Atlantic
Somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean, 1862.
children.cn: 1862年，大西洋的某个地方。
children.notes: in the Atlantic Ocean = 在大西洋
children.statement: 故事发生在1862年的大西洋上。
children.explanation: 句中明确指出了时间和地点：大西洋，1862年。

children.text: The captain sighed.
children.cn: 船长叹了口气。
children.notes: sighed 是 sigh（叹气）的过去式。
children.statement: 船长此时心情非常愉快。
children.explanation: sigh 表示叹气，说明船长遇到了令人担忧的事情。

children.text: This was the thickest fog he had ever seen.
children.cn: 这是他见过的最浓的雾。
children.notes: thickest = 最浓厚的（thick的最高级）；had ever seen = 曾见过的（过去完成时）
children.statement: 这是船长见过最稀薄的雾。
children.explanation: thickest 是 thick 的最高级，意思是“最浓厚的”。

children.text: They were over 330 kilometres from the closest land, so he didn't know where to go.
children.cn: 他们距离最近的陆地有330多公里，所以他不知道该往哪里走。
children.notes: over = 超过；closest = 最近的（close的最高级）；where to go = 往哪里去
children.statement: 船只距离最近的陆地超过330公里。
children.explanation: 句中 'over 330 kilometres from the closest land' 表明距离超过330公里。
children.keywords: 330 kilometres, closest land, where to go

children.text: The ship was on its way to Europe.
children.cn: 这艘船正驶往欧洲。
children.notes: on its way to = 在前往……的途中
children.statement: 这艘船的目的地是欧洲。
children.explanation: on its way to Europe 表示正前往欧洲。

children.text: Just ten hours ago they left New York, but now the engine stopped working.
children.cn: 十个小时前他们刚刚离开纽约，但现在引擎停止工作了。
children.notes: stopped working = 停止运转（stop doing sth.）
children.statement: 船只的引擎运转非常正常。
children.explanation: stopped working 说明引擎出了故障停止工作。
children.keywords: ten hours ago, left New York, engine stopped

children.text: Clearly, they needed help!
children.cn: 很显然，他们需要帮助！
children.notes: Clearly = 显然地（副词修饰整句）
children.statement: Clearly 在这里是副词，表示“显而易见地”。
children.explanation: clearly 是副词，意为“明显地，显然”。

children.cn: 第1部分：迷失在大西洋浓雾中

children.text: The First Pigeon Fails
Suddenly, the captain remembered the homing pigeons.
children.cn: 突然，船长想起了信鸽。
children.notes: homing pigeons = 信鸽（能认路回家的鸽子）
children.statement: homing pigeon 的意思是“野鸽子”。
children.explanation: homing pigeon 意为“信鸽”，因其有归巢本能。

children.text: He ran to them quickly, wrote a message for help, and tied it to Big Blue's leg.
children.cn: 他迅速跑到它们身边，写了一封求救信，并绑在“大蓝”的腿上。
children.notes: tied it to = 把……系在……上（tie的过去式）
children.statement: 船长把求救信息绑在了大蓝的翅膀上。
children.explanation: 文中明确指出是绑在腿上（tied it to Big Blue's leg）。
children.keywords: ran quickly, message for help, Big Blue's leg
children.highlight: message for help, tied it to

children.text: Big Blue flew up and then returned almost right away.
children.cn: 大蓝飞了起来，但几乎马上就飞了回来。
children.notes: right away = 立刻，马上
children.statement: 大蓝成功把求救信送到了陆地上。
children.explanation: 大蓝飞起后马上就飞了回来（returned almost right away），没有完成任务。

children.text: The captain became more worried.
children.cn: 船长变得更加担忧了。
children.notes: more worried = 更加担忧（worried的比较级）
children.statement: 大蓝返回后，船长的心情变得轻松了。
children.explanation: became more worried 说明船长更加焦虑和担心了。

children.cn: 第2部分：第一只信鸽折翼受困

children.text: Arny the Last Hope Takes Off
"You are our last hope, little guy," said the captain as he tied a note to Arny, the smaller and younger of the two pigeons.
children.cn: “你是我们最后的希望了，小家伙，”船长把纸条绑在阿尼身上时说道。阿尼是两只鸽子中体型较小、较年轻的一只。
children.notes: the smaller and younger of the two = 两者中较小且较年轻的（两者比较用the + 比较级）
children.statement: 阿尼是两只信鸽中年龄较大的一只。
children.explanation: 文中指出阿尼是 'the smaller and younger of the two'（较小较年轻的一只）。
children.keywords: last hope, tied a note, Arny, smaller younger
children.highlight: last hope, the smaller and younger of the two

children.text: The captain threw him into the air.
children.cn: 船长将他抛向空中。
children.notes: threw 是 throw（扔，抛）的过去式。
children.statement: threw 是动词 throw 的过去式形式。
children.explanation: throw 的过去式是不规则变化 threw。

children.text: Arny flew around and around, higher and higher.
children.cn: 阿尼盘旋着飞了一圈又一圈，越飞越高。
children.notes: higher and higher = 越来越高（比较级 and 比较级）
children.statement: higher and higher 表示“越来越高”。
children.explanation: “比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”。
children.keywords: around and around, higher and higher

children.text: Soon, the bird was away from the ship, and the captain couldn't see Arny anymore.
children.cn: 很快，这只鸟离开了船，船长再也看不见阿尼了。
children.notes: not... anymore = 不再……
children.statement: 船长一直能清楚地看到阿尼的飞行轨迹。
children.explanation: couldn't see Arny anymore 说明阿尼飞远了，看不到了。
children.keywords: away from ship, couldn't see, anymore

children.text: "That's a good sign," said the captain with more hope.
children.cn: “这是个好兆头，”船长带着更多的希望说道。
children.notes: a good sign = 好兆头，好迹象；with more hope = 带着更多希望
children.statement: 船长看到阿尼飞向远方，重新燃起了希望。
children.explanation: said the captain with more hope 表明船长重获希望。

children.cn: 第3部分：最后的希望阿尼展翅起飞

children.text: Message Delivered and Rescue
Almost 340 kilometres away, Billy heard fast-moving wings come into his building and go straight to the water bowl.
children.cn: 在将近340公里外，比利听到拍打得飞快的翅膀声飞进他的建筑，直接飞向水碗。
children.notes: go straight to = 直奔……；fast-moving = 快速移动的
children.statement: 比利所在的地方距离海上的船只大约340公里。
children.explanation: 文中明确提到 'Almost 340 kilometres away'。
children.keywords: 340 kilometres away, fast-moving wings, water bowl

children.text: "Hi there, little guy. Well, aren't you the thirstiest bird!" Billy smiled.
children.cn: “嗨，小家伙。你可真是最口渴的鸟儿啊！”比利微笑着说。
children.notes: thirstiest = 最口渴的（thirsty的最高级）；aren't you... 否定疑问句表感叹
children.statement: thirstiest 是 thirsty 的最高级形式。
children.explanation: thirsty 以辅音+y结尾，变y为i加est构成了最高级 thirstiest。

children.text: Then he saw the note.
children.cn: 然后他看到了那张纸条。
children.notes: saw 是 see 的过去式。
children.statement: saw 是 see 的过去式。
children.explanation: see 的过去式是不规则变化 saw。

children.text: Billy knew what to do.
children.cn: 比利知道该怎么做。
children.notes: what to do = 疑问词 + 不定式结构
children.statement: Billy knew what to do 说明比利不知所措。
children.explanation: knew what to do 表示他清楚明白该采取什么行动。

children.text: He took the note, running as fast as he could to the company office.
children.cn: 他拿起纸条，以最快的速度跑向公司办公室。
children.notes: as fast as he could = 尽可能快地（as... as one can/could）
children.statement: as fast as he could 表示“尽他所能地快”。
children.explanation: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as one can/could 意为“尽可能……”。
children.keywords: took note, running as fast as, company office

children.text: There, he learnt Arny had flown in fog and over the sea, for more than four hours.
children.cn: 在那里，他了解到阿尼在大雾中和海面上飞行了四个多小时。
children.notes: had flown = 已经飞过（过去完成时）；more than four hours = 四个多小时
children.statement: 阿尼在雾中和大海上飞行的时间不到一小时。
children.explanation: 文中指出飞行了四个多小时（for more than four hours）。
children.keywords: learnt, flown in fog, over sea, four hours

children.text: Thanks to Arny, people sent help to the ship.
children.cn: 多亏了阿尼，人们向船只派出了救援。
children.notes: Thanks to = 多亏，由于；sent 是 send 的过去式
children.statement: Thanks to 在句中表示“多亏了，由于”。
children.explanation: thanks to 是常用短语，表示“归功于，多亏”。
children.keywords: Thanks to Arny, sent help, ship

children.text: The captain later explained, "Arny really is the most amazing bird!"
children.cn: 船长后来解释道：“阿尼真是一只最了不起的鸟！”
children.notes: the most amazing = 最令人惊叹的（多音节词最高级加most）
children.statement: the most amazing 是 amazing 的最高级。
